purpose: independent CPU confirmation of the shifted conformal trajectory cone; no controller return

reference_policy.parameterization: one transformed-Gaussian scalar mean per piston

seeds.reuse_across_cells: common random numbers only; no independence claim across cells

analysis.conformal_rank_rule: ceil((n_calibration+1)*(1-alpha)); infinity if rank exceeds n_calibration
analysis.residual: maximum absolute deviation from launch position-plus-velocity center line, in piston widths
analysis.tube: predicted index interval expanded by ceil(conformal_radius+contact_padding)
analysis.graph: complete directed cache-refresh graph among pistons in the tube
analysis.holdout_coverage: fraction of holdout residuals no larger than the frozen calibration radius
analysis.support_jaccard: edge-set Jaccard between burn-in 5 and burn-in 25 at matched policy seed and horizon

mandatory_gates.C1: all 27 strata and all 10368 trajectories complete and finite; seed groups disjoint
mandatory_gates.C2: runner reads no reward field and uses no controller-performance outcome
mandatory_gates.C3: all 27 conformal radii finite with the frozen rank rule
mandatory_gates.C5: minimum per-stratum holdout coverage at least 0.80
mandatory_gates.C6: horizon-4 median edge-cost fraction at most 0.45 and p90 at most 0.65
mandatory_gates.C7: median horizon-8 minus horizon-4 edge-cost fraction at least 0.10 and nondecreasing cost in at least 7 of 9 policy-by-launch paths
mandatory_gates.C8: median burn-in-5 versus burn-in-25 horizon-4 support Jaccard at most 0.40
mandatory_gates.C9: shift-corrected escape upper bound at most 0.15 for every horizon
mandatory_gates.C10: reported edge counts exactly equal graph cardinality and no graph exceeds 380 edges
mandatory_gates.C11: development seeds and outputs are excluded from all calibration and holdout calculations
mandatory_gates.C12: byte-identical clean reproduction, evaluated only if C1-C11 all pass

stopping_rule: any failure among C1-C11 stops controller preregistration; do not modify thresholds, seeds, strata, or results
authorization_if_passed: may design, but not run, a separately preregistered CPU synthetic Lyapunov controller audit
